contract.meaning: Distinct original receipt floor names, in receipt roll order, separated by comma-space. Explicit receipt null: Sin piso. Missing, ambiguous, unsupported or invalid evidence: Sin evidencia. Mixed floor or partially unknown product rows retain one product row and show every distinct label.
contract.generator: Isolated Orval 8.23.0 run using contract.yaml and orval.config.mjs; generated/ records exact optional TS/Zod field contract. Only this field was transplanted into frozen generated EntradaLinea TS types and the three EntradaDetail Zod responses. No full HEAD codegen.

trace: entradas.tsx capPisos -> lineas[].pisosPorCantidad -> POST /inventario/entradas -> crearEntrada -> rollos.piso_id. API validates active floors belong to selected site.
Released buildEntradaResult uses current rollos.piso_id joined to pisos.nombre; that field is unsuitable for original receipt printing.
Released creation audit CREAR/entradas stores header/count/cost only. Released RECEPCION movements store no floor. Entry schema has no original-floor snapshot.

Searched all released sourcemap app sources containing floor references. Later roll-floor ACTUALIZAR audits, inventory piso_snapshot, reversal physical states and floor catalog audits are later-state evidence, not receipt evidence. They do not establish original floor and are not used.

New creation appends versioned pisosEntrada array to the EXISTING CREAR/entradas event in the same receipt transaction; entries contain rolloId, productoId, pisoId and exact configured nombrePiso. No migration, extra event, update/backfill, or mutation to historical records.

Reader accepts a single creation event with version 1 and exactly one matching roll/product snapshot. Existing history without such evidence is explicitly labeled, not inferred from current roll state.
